description: Synthetic project knowledge for the five sample tasks (W19b ablation smoke). General conventions plus two entries learned from development tasks; nothing comes from validation or sealed tasks. Pipeline check only.

entries.title: Run the visible test before you finish
entries.body: Every library here has a node:test file under test/. Run it with `node --test <file>` and make it pass before you stop. Never edit a test to make it pass.

entries.title: Ranges are inclusive and order-free
entries.body: Range helpers treat both ends as inclusive and accept the bounds in either order: normalise with Math.min / Math.max before looping.

entries.title: Slugs collapse separators
entries.body: Slug and identifier helpers collapse every run of non-alphanumeric characters into one dash and trim dashes at both ends.

entries.title: A cache read is a use
entries.body: In our caches, reading a key counts as using it: a hit moves the key to the most recent position, and a miss changes nothing.

entries.title: Parsers validate the whole input first
entries.body: Before reading values out of a string, check that the entire input matches the grammar (anchor the pattern with ^ and $, allow repetition) and throw on anything else, including the empty string.

entries.title: Libraries are plain ESM
entries.body: Packages are ESM ("type": "module") with no build step and no dependencies. Keep it that way.
